statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study, CPT code 93229, was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential ectopic beats or conduction abnormalities over an extended monitoring period
The claim was denied under reason code CO-50
The denial reason CO-50 indicates that the claim, service, or event is not covered or is not a benefit
The provided records do not align with the information currently maintained in the insurer's system
